exposure: Admission in the latent phase of labor
Admission in the active phase of labor
cohort: 1005 women with uncomplicated singleton pregnancies admitted for spontaneous labor
finding: Admission in the latent phase of labor is associated with more frequent use of epidural analgesia, but not with an increase in cesarean section or adverse neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Admission in the latent phase of labor was associated with more frequent use of epidural analgesia, but not with an increase in cesarean section.
